Instrument.name: The Ion Propulsion System (IPS) Diagnostic Subsystem (IDS) for Deep Space 1
Instrument.description: The Ion Propulsion System Diagnostic Subsystem consisted of 12 sensors intergrated into the spacecraft propulsion system. Two of these sensors were a plasma wave antenna and search coil magnetometer. For the Comet Borrelly encounter, these IDS sensors were reprogrammed in flight to collect E-field and B-field data, respectively, during the encounter.
